name: @migueldsbatista/gemini-cli-openai-bridge
description: High-performance OpenAI (/v1/chat/completions) & Anthropic (/v1/messages) bridge for Google Gemini CLI. Tailored for OpenCode, Claude Code, Roo Code & Aider.
author: Miguel de Sousa Batista

scripts.install: git submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1 && cd gemini-cli && npm install
scripts.port: rimraf gemini-cli/packages/bridge-server && shx cp -r bridge-server gemini-cli/packages/ && shx cp LICENSE gemini-cli/packages/bridge-server/ && shx cp README.md gemini-cli/packages/bridge-server/ && cd gemini-cli/packages/bridge-server && npm install
scripts.prepare: npm run install && npm run port && npm run compile
scripts.test: cd gemini-cli && npx vitest run packages/bridge-server
scripts.pack:bridge-server: npm run build && cd gemini-cli/packages/bridge-server && npm pack
scripts.publish:bridge-server: npm run build && cd gemini-cli/packages/bridge-server && npm publish --access public
